notes.title: Prologue Update v 1.0.1
notes.content:
We have updated the prologue of Crack it up! to match the demo version which will be available during the Steam Fest, so if you have already downloaded the Prologue just update it and you will get the same version as the demo!

We're excited to bring you a new update with several improvements and fixes. Here’s what’s new:


 Prevent Selling Your Last Card: We've added a safeguard to prevent you from accidentally selling the last copy of a card.
 Audio Fixes: Fixed some overlapping sound effects that were playing at the same time.
 New Stats Section: You can now view detailed statistics about your game in the computer, including total money spent, packs opened, and more!
 Card Placement Bug Fix: Resolved an issue where cards would be placed incorrectly on the table if clicked too quickly after appearing.
 Table Space Limit: If your table is full, you won’t be able to buy new packs until there’s more space.
 Improved Navigation: You can now switch between different screens in the game by using the left and right arrow keys, A and D keys, or the numbers 1 to 3. 


We hope these changes enhance your experience! Let us know what you think, and happy playing!
